item.title: Sakurairo Quartet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BerkshireYorkshire
  • 発売日: 2011-04-08
  • スコア: 7.08/10 (51 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくら色カルテット
  • 英語名: Sakurairo Quartet

あらすじ

In the near future, bioroids called Iris were created using genes from animals to be the perfect partner for humans. They now live together with humans in harmony. Ryouta is a meddlesome student at Kurama Gakuen who comes upon a stray Iris named Sakura. He decides to take her under his wing and to become her master, but then Sakura’s older sister Ui shows up, along with a suspicious guy Ogami Shingo. Even his schoolmates Ayano and Momoka get involved. It seems that she holds many secrets…

あらすじ

Seiji is back to his hometown and Aoi, his old friend, Akane, his classmate, and Hinano, his younger sister help him move to his new house. All of a sudden, a girl falls down his room. Her name is Chocolat and she is a magical girl, according to her. She casts magic to repair the roof of his house, but it fails and all of them become able to use magic instead…. Also, Seiji’s body changes and he can’t stop chasing girls. To get back to normal, he needs a full-fledged magical girl, but there is none. Seiji finally makes up his mind to train one of them to become a full-fledged magical girl….
